interpretation: R-Masked in the operator request is treated as R-Matched: segment-specific rich captions aligned to each first-10-second training window.

quarter_control.treatment: R-Shared: one deterministic rich caption source per track broadcast to every retained segment row

promotion_gate.contrast: existing R-Matched quarter minus new R-Shared quarter
promotion_gate.technical_failure_policy: Missing/invalid corpus binding, checkpoint, audit, or metric blocks promotion. A low but finite R-Shared score remains a valid scientific result and does not independently veto promotion.
promotion_gate.rationale: Promote only if segment-specific rich captions materially improve CLAP while CE is non-inferior within the preregistered quarter null band. Full scale is intended to optimize combined CLAP and AES, not either metric alone.
